symptom: ako/mxcli#2210: `theme create glass2 --from tokens.css --base console` with a design seeding only --mxt-font (Inter) wrote no woff2 and no @font-face, while custom-variables.scss still had --mxt-font-mono: "JetBrains Mono" (the base's value) - a stack naming a font the theme no longer ships.
cause: unusedVendoredFamilies compared the vendored families against the SEEDED font stacks only, so a family named by a token the design left at the base's value counted as unused and planFonts dropped its @font-face and files.
file: cmd/mxcli/theme/create_seeded.go (unusedVendoredFamilies, resultingFontStacks, planFonts reads the base's custom-variables.scss)
insight: What a theme loads is decided by its RESULTING values (seeded where set, the base's otherwise), not by what the design said; a var(--mxt-font) heading must be resolved against those same resulting stacks, so console's heading follows a seeded body font and Space Grotesk is rightly dropped. The existing tests all seeded mono alongside the body font, so the partial-seed case was never exercised.
